checks.lead: Sayf ad-Din Qutuz (Arabic: سيف الدين قطز; died 24 October 1260), also romanized as Kutuz or Kotuz and fully al-Malik al-Muẓaffar Sayf ad-Dīn Quṭuz (الملك المظفر سيف الدين قطز lit. 'The Victorious King, Sword of the Faith Qutuz'), was the Sultan of Egypt. He reigned as Mamluk sultan for less than a year, from 1259 until his assassination in 1260, but served as Egypt's de facto ruler for two decades.
